name: terminal-v1
description: Offline one-command shell tasks (coreutils/awk/sed/sort only) over a small fixture directory; checked by exact stdout. Used by scripts/terminal_rsi.py (#88). evolve = trajectories are collected and self-rewritten; holdout = only for base vs refined comparison, never shown to the model's rewrite step.

fixture.words.txt:
pear apple pear
fig apple kiwi
fixture.app.log:
INFO start
ERROR disk full
WARN slow
ERROR disk full
INFO stop

tasks.prompt: Print only the number of lines in data.txt (just the number).
Print the distinct words of words.txt, one per line, sorted alphabetically.
Print how many lines of app.log contain ERROR (just the number).
Print the third line of data.txt.
List the names (without directory) of the .log files in the logs directory, sorted, one per line.
Print conf.ini with every occurrence of foo replaced by bar (do not modify the file).
Print the sum of the qty column of sales.csv (skip the header; just the number).
Print the last line of app.log.
Print how many times the word apple appears in words.txt (just the number).
Print the distinct lines of app.log that start with ERROR, sorted, one per line.
Print the lines of data.txt sorted in reverse alphabetical order.
Print how many files in the logs directory end in .txt (just the number).
